misprints.note: Last word of the strip is printed with smooth breathing and a circumflex; the preposition εἰς was meant.
No iota subscript visible under τῆ, where other datives on the page show one clearly.
The full stop after l (= el.) is missing in the print.

uncertain.note: The iota subscript may be missing in the print or may only have printed faintly; I transcribed it as τῆ.
The full stop after 3 is a very small, faint dot; I read it as a period.
